about: Program Manager's groups as both engines read and write them (src/layers/groups.ts, crates/winbox-win16/src/groups.rs; test/layers/groups_test.ts, crates/winbox-win16/tests/groups.rs). Synthetic: groups made by Program Manager's own operations from made-up items and 8 by 8 icons, PROGMAN.INI texts, commands, and a stack of them. `expected` is written by the TypeScript test with GROUPS_UPDATE=1.
